title: The bird at the gate
logline: The logging road's gate, still open from the sequence three months done, and the bird on its top rail. The road up behind it plain in June daylight, no glow. The page checks on both things.

panels.composition: A steel gate across a logging road standing open in June daylight, the small rainbow bird on its top rail, the gravel road climbing behind into ordinary green trees with no glow.
